tos.title: Terms of Service

tos.s2_body: The Service is available to users of all ages, except where restricted by the laws of the user's country of residence. Minors must obtain consent from a parent or legal guardian before using the Service.
tos.s3_body: The Service is an application that helps users manage their subscription information in one place. The Service is currently provided free of charge. The Operator may modify or discontinue the Service with prior notice.
tos.s4_body: An account registration is required to use the Service. Users are responsible for keeping their registration information accurate and up to date. Users are solely responsible for managing their account credentials and must not transfer or lend them to any third party. Accounts may be suspended or deleted if false information is registered.
tos.s5_body:
Users must not engage in any of the following activities:

· Unauthorized access, reverse engineering, or equivalent analysis of the Service
· Unauthorized use of the Service for commercial purposes
· Harassment or nuisance behavior toward other users
· Activities that violate laws, regulations, or public order and morals
· Denial-of-service (DoS) attacks or other actions that place excessive load on the Service's servers
· Any other activities deemed inappropriate by the Operator
tos.s6_body: Data entered by users, such as subscription information, is stored securely on servers managed by the Operator. Collected information is used solely to provide and improve the Service, and personal information will not be sold or provided to third parties. For details, please refer to the separate Privacy Policy.
tos.s7_body: The Operator may suspend or delete an account without prior notice if a user violates these Terms or if the Operator determines there is other legitimate cause. Users who wish to delete their account may contact the Operator through the contact page.
tos.s8_body: The Operator makes no representations or warranties, express or implied, regarding the Service. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the Operator shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use of or inability to use the Service, except in cases of intentional misconduct or gross negligence. Users are responsible for verifying the accuracy of their subscription information.
tos.s9_body: The Operator may update these Terms at any time as deemed necessary. Updated Terms will take effect upon notification within the Service or upon posting on the Service. Continued use of the Service after any change constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.
tos.s10_body: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Japan. Any disputes relating to the Service shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Tokyo District Court as the court of first instance.
